purpose: Acquire complete goal inventory for the one remaining current assist-inventory fixture. Reuse unchanged qualified source parser and native goal/scorer/identity gates. No foul/penalty counter application.
source: Public ESPN eng.1 scoreboard by fixture date and event-scoped summary; exact response bytes retained.
development: Leicester-Everton and Norwich-Arsenal, 2019-12-01, inspected only for source schema before control selection.
selection: Only 2022-23 fixture 290, the 15 remaining current inventory requirements. Existing 30-control fixture qualification reused; no new holdout claim.
identity: Unique date/home/away identity, exact final scores, completed FT. Unique native roster name match within actual historical club, reciprocal athlete matching, globally consistent season/player code versus ESPN athlete ID. Unknown/ambiguous identities abstain. In this separate version, exact normalized public ESPN fullName matches against previously verified official Pulse/Opta-coded display names rank above shortened-name matching. Require unique native club-specific code and global reciprocal identities; use no event outcome to choose an identity.
fouls_won: Use only explicit finite nonnegative integer foulsSuffered from an explicit one-appearance roster record. Never use omitted values as zero.
penalty_goals: Require unique complete non-shootout scoring-event inventory equal to final scores, recognized goal/goal-header/own-goal or exact id98 penalty---scored type, all scorer identities, and each participant's goal and own-goal counts equal native FPL. Count exact id98 events per scorer; zero requires the complete inventory. Unknown goal types, cancelled/incomplete events or conflicting score/scorer vectors abstain for the fixture.

validation.all: Freeze predictions before comparing closed-ledger outcomes; compare all available closed values in fetched fixtures, including protected values outside planned controls. Any conflict blocks the field globally. Report shared-source/previously observed regression limits and retain collective quality flags. This is an additional source-specific qualification, not a replacement or reduction of prior gates. Penalty control references also include explicit archived attPenGoal and native FPL goals_scored=0 subset bounds; these are reported separately. An omitted source penalty counter for a goal scorer is never zero. Preserve original global foul mapping failure; it is not reopened by this identity repair.

application: Only absent missing_data penalty_goals/fouls_won fields. Preserve every other ledger cell and all raw/native fields, approved values, locked scoring and models. Acquire commentary/key events for later use without treating provider goalAssists as target-rule assists.
